extension.description: MarkReview is a lightweight VS Code extension that brings inline CriticMarkup review into Markdown, supporting AI-assisted, single-file editing: add comments, suggestions, and deletion markup directly in the document, then generate clean outputs without external sidecar comment storage.
viewsWelcome.comments:
Open a Markdown source file to see CriticMarkup review items.
[Open Markdown Source](command:markReview.openSource)
